name: po-claude-toolkit
description: Product Owner toolkit for Obsidian + Claude Code: git-like sync between an Obsidian vault and Confluence, plus creation of pages, folders and whole project trees, with panels, decisions, tasks, statuses, images, Jira links, Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams and user mentions that round-trip. Also morning and evening routines for the daily note: the morning one builds it from the calendar, tasks, Gmail and Jira, the evening one completes it with meeting recaps, project tags, corrections and an End of day recap. Plus a user story writer that turns a Jira draft into a finished story, not tied to Obsidian.

plugins.name: confluence-sync
plugins.description: Four risk-separated skills for git-like Confluence sync from an Obsidian vault: status (read-only), link, pull, push. Paste a Confluence URL to link a note or folder, search pages by title, detect conflicts before they bite, and scaffold a whole project tree from a template.

plugins.name: daily-note
plugins.description: Morning and evening routines for an Obsidian vault: /daily-note:start-my-day builds today's daily note with a short Summary, an Alert list, what waits on you (Slack, Confluence, Jira, Docs) and one heading per meeting. /daily-note:end-my-day adds task notes for the tasks marked #note, missing meetings, Gemini transcript links with a short recap, the notes created or edited today, the decisions made on Slack, project tags, text-corrector fixes, a short End of day and a Review list, then offers to go through the Review one question per item. meeting-recap recaps one meeting on request. task-note gives a task a note to write in, linked in the task line. end-my-day can close a past day, and im-back builds a catch-up note after time off.

plugins.name: user-stories
plugins.description: User story tools for a PO, not tied to Obsidian. us-craft turns a rough draft or one-line Jira ticket into a finished story in the Antoine template. It reads the parent epic, related stories, the Confluence feature page and Figma, asks the PO what is still open, proposes a split when the story is too big, then writes behavior-only scenarios with error, state and permission cases, Medfar healthcare checks and a Vocab Table of every UI text.
